title: Famicom Mini 24 - Hikari Shinwa - Palthena no Kagami (Japan)

magic_signatures.description: 8-byte Nintendo GBA NES-wrapper boot stamp (rom[0xC0..0xC8], tag 'PART') at EEPROM block 0x1FF (rev8-logical 0xFF8..0xFFF).

fields.name: slot_0_build_timestamp
fields.description: Slot 0 4-byte BCD build timestamp (MMDDHHmm) copied from ROM header 0x080000C0..0x080000C3.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 0 (EEPROM block 0x00, rev8-logical 0x000) and verifies them on load.

fields.name: slot_0_build_tag
fields.description: Slot 0 8-byte ASCII build tag ('PARTHENA') copied from ROM header 0x080000C4..0x080000CB.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 0 (rev8-logical 0x004..0x00B).

fields.name: slot_0_format_version
fields.description: Slot 0 EEPROM wrapper record format version (always 0x02).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator writes constant 0x02 to header+0x0C (rev8-logical 0x00C) and rejects records where byte 0x0C != 0x02.

fields.name: slot_0_seq_toggle
fields.description: Slot 0 A/B ping-pong commit toggle (0 or 1, inverted on each save commit).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator toggles header+0x0D via XOR 1 on each commit (rev8-logical 0x00D) and selects the active slot between block 0x00 and block 0x200.

fields.name: slot_0_crc16
fields.description: Slot 0 reflected CRC-16 (poly=0xD0A2, init=0, +1 trailing zero u32) over 0x110 bytes with header+0x0E..0x0F zeroed.
fields.evidence: VRAM ARM CRC-16 routine (poly 0xD0A2, subs r1, r1, #4; bpl) computes u16 LE over rev8-logical 0x000..0x110 and stores at 0x00E.

fields.name: slot_0_payload
fields.description: Slot 0 game save payload (256 bytes; total record 0x110 bytes = 34 EEPROM blocks).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator transfers 34 8-byte EEPROM blocks per slot starting at block 0x00 (rev8-logical 0x010..0x110).

fields.name: boot_stamp
fields.description: 8-byte boot stamp (rom[0xC0..0xC8]) written on first boot at EEPROM block 0x1FF.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator reads/writes 8-byte stamp from 0x080000C0 at EEPROM block 0x1FF (rev8-logical 0xFF8..0xFFF).

fields.name: slot_1_build_timestamp
fields.description: Slot 1 4-byte BCD build timestamp (MMDDHHmm) copied from ROM header 0x080000C0..0x080000C3.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 1 (EEPROM block 0x200, rev8-logical 0x1000) and verifies them on load.

fields.name: slot_1_build_tag
fields.description: Slot 1 8-byte ASCII build tag ('PARTHENA') copied from ROM header 0x080000C4..0x080000CB.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 1 (rev8-logical 0x1004..0x100B).

fields.name: slot_1_format_version
fields.description: Slot 1 EEPROM wrapper record format version (always 0x02).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator writes constant 0x02 to header+0x0C (rev8-logical 0x100C) and rejects records where byte 0x0C != 0x02.

fields.name: slot_1_seq_toggle
fields.description: Slot 1 A/B ping-pong commit toggle (0 or 1, inverted on each save commit).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator toggles header+0x0D via XOR 1 on each commit (rev8-logical 0x100D) and selects the active slot between block 0x00 and block 0x200.

fields.name: slot_1_crc16
fields.description: Slot 1 reflected CRC-16 (poly=0xD0A2, init=0, +1 trailing zero u32) over 0x110 bytes with header+0x0E..0x0F zeroed.
fields.evidence: VRAM ARM CRC-16 routine (poly 0xD0A2, subs r1, r1, #4; bpl) computes u16 LE over rev8-logical 0x1000..0x1110 and stores at 0x100E.

fields.name: slot_1_payload
fields.description: Slot 1 game save payload (256 bytes; total record 0x110 bytes = 34 EEPROM blocks).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator transfers 34 8-byte EEPROM blocks per slot starting at block 0x200 (rev8-logical 0x1010..0x1110).
